hikes.name: Snow Lake
hikes.blurb: Washington's most-hiked wilderness trail, over a rocky ridge to a big, deep lake under Chair Peak.

hikes.name: Kendall Katwalk
hikes.blurb: North on the Pacific Crest Trail to a ledge blasted across a sheer granite face.

hikes.name: Rachel Lake and Rampart Lakes
hikes.blurb: Up a waterfall-filled valley to a cirque lake, then over to a set of granite tarns on a high bench.

hikes.name: Franklin Falls
hikes.blurb: An easy family walk along the South Fork Snoqualmie to a 70-foot falls in a rock bowl.

hikes.name: Melakwa Lake via Denny Creek
hikes.blurb: Past slick-rock waterslides and two falls to a pass and a clear lake under Kaleetan Peak.

hikes.name: Annette Lake
hikes.blurb: Steady forest switchbacks to a lake at the foot of Silver Peak's cliffs.

hikes.name: Granite Mountain Lookout
hikes.blurb: A relentless 3,800-foot climb to a lookout that sees Rainier, Baker and the whole I-90 corridor.

hikes.name: Pratt Lake
hikes.blurb: Over a forested ridge past Talapus and Olallie Lakes' basins down to a long lake under Pratt Mountain.

hikes.name: Talapus and Olallie Lakes
hikes.blurb: A gentle climb to two forest lakes, good for an easy summer swim.

hikes.name: Lodge Lake
hikes.blurb: South on the Pacific Crest Trail under the ski runs to a small lake in the woods.

hikes.name: Commonwealth Basin and Red Pass
hikes.blurb: Through a quiet meadow basin and up to a notch looking down into the Middle Fork Snoqualmie.

hikes.name: Gem Lake
hikes.blurb: Past Snow Lake and up to a smaller, rockier lake with views across to Chair Peak.

hikes.name: Blazer Lake
hikes.blurb: From Ira Spring Trailhead, a 9.3-mile round trip to Blazer Lake, with about 3,200 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Rachel Lake
hikes.blurb: From Rampart Ridge Backdoor Trailhead, a 7.1-mile round trip to Rachel Lake, with about 3,050 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Lila Lake
hikes.blurb: From Rampart Ridge Backdoor Trailhead, a 7.4-mile round trip to Lila Lake, with about 3,000 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Hibox Mountain
hikes.blurb: From Rachel Lake Trailhead, a 6.6-mile round trip to the top of Hibox Mountain (6,422 ft), with about 3,750 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Alta Mountain
hikes.blurb: From Rampart Ridge Backdoor Trailhead, an 8.4-mile round trip to the top of Alta Mountain (6,230 ft), with about 3,600 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Trico Mountain
hikes.blurb: From Tucquala Meadows Trailhead, a 14.7-mile round trip to the top of Trico Mountain (6,643 ft), with about 4,050 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Mount Daniel
hikes.blurb: From Cathedral Pass Trailhead, a 14.7-mile round trip to the top of Mount Daniel (7,946 ft), with about 5,400 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Alaska Mountain
hikes.blurb: From PCT Horse Trailhead Parking, a 15.2-mile round trip to the top of Alaska Mountain (5,722 ft), with about 4,150 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Florence Falls
hikes.blurb: From Dorothy Lake Trailhead, a 2.6-mile round trip to Florence Falls, with about 850 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Mount Roosevelt
hikes.blurb: From Snow Lake Trailhead, a 10.6-mile round trip to the top of Mount Roosevelt (5,027 ft), with about 3,200 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Margaret Lake
hikes.blurb: From Mount Margaret/Lake Lillian Trailhead Parking, a 5.4-mile round trip to Margaret Lake, with about 1,950 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Marten Lake
hikes.blurb: From Snoqualmie Lake Trailhead, a 7.6-mile round trip to Marten Lake, with about 1,850 feet of climbing.
